title: Finite etale model across a regular codimension-two boundary
statement: Let L be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and V an open. Assume that every point of L outside V has a regular local stalk [def-weil-regular-scheme] of Krull dimension at least two [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For any finite morphism p : E -> L [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] whose restriction to V is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], there is a finite etale morphism r : F -> L with source stalk depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth] above the complement of V and an isomorphism between the restrictions of p and r to V commuting with their structure maps. No source-depth assumption on p is needed.

proof.text: Use a minimal generating set of the regular local maximal ideal. The regular-generator theorem makes it a regular sequence of length the Krull dimension. Its length enters the supremum defining depth, so each boundary target stalk has depth at least two.

Apply the existing depth-two finite extension theorem to the etale cover p restricted to V. Obtain a finite morphism r with source boundary depth two and an isomorphism from its restriction to that cover.
At each boundary point apply punctured-spectrum regular-local purity, Tag 0BMA. The local-purity depth-two finite flatness theorem then makes r flat.

The existing flat depth-two extension theorem gives formal unramifiedness. Finiteness gives local finite presentation, so flatness and formal unramifiedness give Etale r. Retain the source depth bound and invert the restriction isomorphism to obtain the required comparison with p.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BMA, 0EY7 and 0EY6(2),(3); global depth-two extension followed by minimal nonflat fibre argument

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_etale_depth_two_model
    {L E : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (V : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ V → IsRegularLocalRing (L.presheaf.stalk y) ∧
      (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p] [Etale (p ∣_ V)] :
    ∃ (F : Scheme.{u}) (r : F ⟶ L), IsFinite r ∧ Etale r ∧
      (∀ z : F, r z ∉ V →
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk z) (F.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ r ∣_ V = p ∣_ V
